relationships.subject: LY294002
relationships.evidence_quote: inhibition of the P13K/Akt pathway reversed the protective effect of KuA on LPS-induced NPCs

relationships.subject: LPS
relationships.evidence_quote: the protein levels of matrix metalloproteinase 13 (MMP13) and a disintegrin like and metalloproteinase with thrombospondin type I motifs 5 (ADAMTS5) were elevated in LPS-induced NPCs compared with the control group

relationships.subject: Kukoamine A
relationships.evidence_quote: but were steadily declined in the LPS+KuA (10, 20, 40 µM) groups

key_findings: Kukoamine A reduces LPS-induced apoptosis, ECM degradation and inflammation in nucleus pulposus cells.
The protection depends on PI3K/Akt activation, as LY294002 reverses it.
